'''Drew Houston''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 1999 New Brunswick tournament]] on 4 December 1999 with Death Star drain deck, according to Scott Lingrell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d133">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-04-new-brunswick-new-jersey-12-4-99d133/ new-brunswick-new-jersey-12-4-99], DeckTech (Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell, 4 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-04-new-brunswick-new-jersey-12-4-99d133/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
